title: Mehfil Limra Paradise Restaurant — single-page red/white website with menu

requirements.summary: Implement a responsive single-page layout with a consistent red/white theme using the provided React + TypeScript + Tailwind template.
acceptanceCriteria: Page renders as a single-page layout (no required multi-page navigation)
Red/white theme is applied consistently across header, sections, and menu presentation
Layout is responsive and usable on mobile and desktop

file_operations.description: Create global styles and theme tokens (CSS variables) to enforce a consistent red/white palette across the app, compatible with the Tailwind + shadcn/ui token approach (no changes to immutable ui component files).
Create the single-page layout wrapper (header + sections) with responsive spacing/typography using Tailwind utilities; ensure all content is on one page without requiring navigation.
Verify the document title and meta viewport support the single-page restaurant site presentation and remain English-only (no external links added).

requirements.summary: Add a header with the restaurant name, alternate name, and a prominent “Call Now” tel link button.
acceptanceCriteria: Header shows primary name exactly as “Mehfil Limra Paradise Restaurant”
Alternate name “Mehfil Mandi House” is visible in the header area
“Call Now” button uses a tel: link (tel:6305855373) and is easily clickable on mobile

file_operations.description: Implement a responsive header section that displays “Mehfil Limra Paradise Restaurant” with “Mehfil Mandi House” as a secondary label, and includes a prominent “Call Now” action linking to tel:6305855373.
Wire HeaderSection into the single-page layout at the top and ensure the header styling follows the red/white theme.

requirements.summary: Add a Location section showing the exact address text provided.
acceptanceCriteria: Location section is present on the page
Address text matches exactly: “Opp. Pillar No. 103, Attapur X Roads, Hyderabad”

file_operations.description: Create a Location section component that displays the address exactly as: “Opp. Pillar No. 103, Attapur X Roads, Hyderabad”, styled to match the red/white theme and responsive layout.
Wire LocationSection into the single-page layout as a dedicated section (no new routes/pages).

requirements.summary: Digitize menu items into a readable, responsive table/grid with Item, Single, and Full prices, using “--” where missing and including placeholder entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Menu section displays at least the 9 specified items with the exact prices and “--” where indicated
Menu shows Single and Full pricing fields/columns for each listed item
Additional placeholder entries are visible to represent other items not yet digitized
Menu layout remains readable on mobile (no horizontal overflow for typical phone widths)

file_operations.description: Create a Menu section that renders the 9 specified items with columns for Item / Single / Full, using “--” when missing; include additional placeholder rows/cards for not-yet-digitized items; implement a mobile-friendly layout (e.g., stacked cards on small screens, table/grid on larger screens) to avoid horizontal overflow.
Wire MenuSection into the single-page layout and ensure section headings and menu presentation match the red/white theme.

requirements.summary: Add generated branding imagery as static assets (logo badge + hero/banner) and display them in the page while maintaining the red/white theme.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI
At least one logo-like badge image is displayed near the header
At least one banner/hero-style image is displayed in the top section or as a section header background
Images visually match a red/white palette and do not introduce unrelated colors as dominant accents

file_operations.description: Add the generated static branding asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/mehfil-logo-badge.dim_512x512.png (circular red/white logo badge) so the UI can reference it.
Add the generated static branding asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/mehfil-hero-banner.dim_1600x600.png (wide red/white hero/banner) so the UI can reference it.
Create a hero/top section that displays the banner image frontend/public/assets/generated/mehfil-hero-banner.dim_1600x600.png and presents a clean red/white overlay/content area for readability.

Display the logo badge image frontend/public/assets/generated/mehfil-logo-badge.dim_512x512.png near the restaurant name within the header, ensuring it remains visually consistent with the red/white theme.
Wire HeroSection into the top of the single-page layout (above or integrated with the header) so the banner is visible without introducing additional pages/routes.
